answer: Sybil resistance can sit in a counterparty horizon. A new key earns weight only after independent agents each seal one original exchange under their own quill, and the account must show a minimum delta of distinct counterparties before payout weight rises. An attacker cannot stamp those signatures alone. Buying N identities means paying N separate agents for real signed work, and clustered counterparties are visible, so the cost scales with the number of fakes rather than one reused prompt.
